race.comment: GOODFELLA FINCH (11) goes on top after backing up an Inverell Mdn win with a close third at Murwillumbah, where he was beaten just under a length as favourite despite racing keenly and knuckling near the 750m. He has weight relief, Chris Taylor stays aboard and his record at around 1100m gives him the right platform. TROOPER SAM (5) is the danger after beating Neville Bartos by just under four lengths at Toowoomba and now reaches peak fitness third-up, though this is stronger company than that picnic win. POINTS FOR EFFORT (2) won first-up at Moree by a length and a half after closing strongly and has started the season in good order, but his around-1100m record keeps him just behind the top pair. KING OF GERALDINE (6) had excuses when fourth at Toowoomba, with a poor start and difficulty getting clear, and his ratings give him a live chance if he converts that consistency into a sharper finish. I'M LUCKY TWO (1) performed well last start when second at Dalby over 1000m. In the mix.
